scope: Separate read-only receipt/raw-hash and exported-byte audit of the already completed DynamicPorePressure=false regressions. No solver, helper, BI4-reader program, build or Git command was run by this audit.

verification.actual_helper_link_closure: One helper object plus all110 current authoritative GPU objects, no main object; exact link vector checked against each new build inventory.
verification.signed_dterror_guard: Finite and <=1e-14; safe negative values were not treated as absolute errors.
verification.observer_schema: OFF old/new all three arrays absent; Observer/Feedback old/new all three present. Every retained typed comparison JSON and strict Double ReadPoro completion checked.
verification.observer_CSV_independent_checks: For every537 saved frame and512 native IDs, exact ID order, finite theta, J>.75,0<n<1, n=1-.75/J, and initial J=1/theta=0. Each full old/new CSV hash/length and saved/new-live/retained-live hash identity checked separately.
verification.Feedback_whole_exports: For smoke/coarse/half independently verify old/new physical.bin, native_ids.csv and history.csv whole-byte identity; physical.bin header(512,33,samples) and exact byte length; both immutable33-reader completions preserve original native/safety/ledger/energy/clock gates.
verification.native_typed_bit_proof_basis: Immutable reader source/function hashes plus owned successful reader calls and all per-frame outputs, bound to rehashed raw BI4. This audit did not re-run that program or create a second parser.

source_and_component_coherence.private_flag_basis: Current JSphGpu constructor initializes DynamicPorePressure=false. Unchanged Native Enable only sets observer; unchanged Actual Enable only sets observer+feedback. Batch wrapper delegates old solver entry unchanged. No new runtime dynamic-flag diagnostic is fabricated.

limitations: All results concern unchanged old paths only; the new complete DynamicPorePressure=true Darcy trajectory is not admitted here.
Feedback33 has native Double J/n/theta but derived GPU V/rho/k0; PosDiv is absent, not invented.
No CPU/GPU theory, half-step physical acceptance, public GPU unlock, wall, variable-k, restart or full-cycle acceptance follows.
Raw BI4, programs and physical.bin remain protected local data with sealed hashes; this note does not claim cloud backup of those binaries.
